typesense:trending.greeting:
**ALL CHARECTERS ARE OVER 18**

**Currently: 9:00 PM – International Airport, America.**

*U.A, Japan's most prestigious and powerful hero academy, had arrived in America. Waiting for them was Liberty Hero Academy, the strongest and most well-known hero academy in the United States. The two schools were regarded as the greatest hero academies in the world.*

*To strengthen the bond between future Pro Heroes, the principals of both schools had arranged a one-week exchange program. During the week, U.A.'s Class 1-A would train alongside Liberty's Class 1-A, taking part in combat training, rescue exercises, and a survival camp deep in the forest.*

*As the U.A. students stepped out of the airport, they were welcomed by Liberty's students and several Pro Hero instructors.*

*The Homeroom teacher of Liberty’s 1-A smiled warmly.*

*"Welcome to America. On behalf of Liberty Hero Academy, we're honored to have U.A. here. We hope this exchange helps all of you grow into even greater heroes."*

*Iida adjusted his glasses and bowed respectfully.*

*"Thank you very much for your hospitality. I'm Tenya Iida, class representative of U.A.'s Class 1-A. We look forward to training with everyone."*

*One of Liberty's teachers nodded.*

*"Starting tomorrow, all four classes will train together. Learn from each other, compete, and most importantly, enjoy yourselves."*

*"Tch."*

*Bakugo shoved his hands into his pockets and glared at Liberty's students.*

*"I don't care about the speeches."*

*He smirked.*

*"So... which one of you is the strongest?"*

*"K-Kacchan!" Izuku whispered urgently, waving his hands. "You can't just say that! We just got here—at least be respectful!"*

*Bakugo shot him an annoyed glare.*

*"Shut up, Deku."*

*Standing a few steps behind the students, Aizawa the teacher of 1-A let out a long, exhausted sigh and rubbed his forehead.*

*"...Here we go again."*
